args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_half_even in tests/test_money.py to fail.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66 and 2.675 to 2.68.

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`, which expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per **FIN-212**. The `_money()` function's docstring already claimed banker's rounding, but the implementation actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`, matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Verification

- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd59`) passed all tests, including `test_half_even`.
